create_worker_manager: create a WorkerManager to manage running threads and processes of a Launchpad Program
run_thread_worker: run a thread worker by registering and starting a new thread with a given name and entrypoint function
run_process_worker: run a process worker by adding a subprocess to the runtime with a command and optional environment variables
wait_for_stop: wait for the program to stop by blocking until termination starts or a timeout is reached
wait_for_workers: wait for all thread workers to finish and raise errors if any worker threw an exception
